facts.text: Test Publish_IndexIsDeterministic seeds the same 12 by 12 tree into two databases, publishes both at IndexMaxTokens 800, and asserts matching index file names with identical content.
Test Publish_IndexIsDeterministic publishes twice into the same store before comparing, so a repeated publish must leave the index files unchanged.
Test Publish_IndexLinksResolveAndReachEverySubject posts a root subject named Top Level and publishes with IndexMaxTokens 700 before checking links.
at: db.Store.PostFacts(Fixtures.Post("Top Level", Fixtures.Fact("Lives at the root.")));

facts.text: Test Publish_IndexLinksResolveAndReachEverySubject asserts every non-http link ending in .md inside each index file resolves to a file that the bundle contains.
Test Publish_IndexShowsGroupsWhenTooLarge posts four groups of ten leaves and asserts index/big.md holds a group row and links to big-g0.md rather than to subject directories.
Test Publish_IndexShowsGroupsWhenTooLarge asserts the manifest index_files value for index/big.md equals EstimateTokens of that file's content.
Test Publish_IndexShowsGroupsWhenTooLarge asserts the group page big-g0.md links down to a subject index and back up with Up: to big.md.
Test Publish_AgentsMdDescribesTieredIndex asserts the written AGENTS.md repeats while the row is a group and states that a row being a folder is normal.
at: await Assert.That(agents).Contains("index/<group>.md (repeat while the row is a group)");

facts.text: Test Publish_SmallBundleHasOnlyRootIndex asserts a default publish of the seeded tree writes exactly 1 index file.
Test Publish_EachFactLivesUnderItsSubject posts three facts to Trio and asserts all 3 fact paths start with subjects/trio/facts/ while no top-level facts directory exists.
Test Publish_FactRefLinksResolve asserts an in-subject ref links by bare file name while a cross-subject ref climbs ../../beta-subject/facts/ to reach the far fact file.
Test Publish_FactRefLinksResolve asserts the far fact file links back to the pointer fact annotated with note and rel: depends_on.
Test Publish_SlotRefResolvesToLiveFact asserts a Config#theme slot ref renders a link to the fact occupying that slot, and that occupant notes rel: reads.
Test Publish_SlotRefResolvesToLiveFact replaces the slot occupant, republishes, and asserts the reader link points at the new head while the old fact file is gone.
Test Publish_SubjectRefLinksToSubjectIndex asserts subject refs given by id and by lower-case name both render links ending in ../../team-atlas/index.md and ../../team-atlas-docs/index.md.
Test Publish_SubjectRefLinksToSubjectIndex asserts the child subject index names its parent on a Parent line linking to ../team-atlas/index.md.
Test Publish_UnresolvedSlotStaysText asserts each unresolvable slot target renders as unresolved slot text with the target quoted and no link markup.
Test Publish_IndexLinksResolveAndReachEverySubject asserts the subject index count equals 15 times 15 plus 1 and that following only group rows from INDEX.md reaches exactly those files.
Test Publish_ExternalRefsStayTextExceptHttpLinks asserts only the http ref becomes a link, using an angle-bracketed destination, while the file and git refs stay plain target lines.
Test Publish_EveryInternalLinkResolves asserts for both budgets that the number of fact files equals factIds.Count plus 1.
Test Publish_EveryInternalLinkResolves runs the publish at budgets 1200 and 60 and asserts the fact files contain slot links, an unresolved slot, index.md links and asset links.
Test Publish_EveryInternalLinkResolves builds a Pkg root with 6 module subjects, each holding 4 class subjects that carry fact, slot, subject, unresolved, http and file refs.
Test Publish_SubjectDirectoryIsRemovedWhenSubjectIsGone retracts every doomed fact and asserts the subjects/doomed directory is gone, its index.md is in Removed, and a foreign notes.txt survives.
Test Publish_SubjectDirectoryIsRemovedWhenSubjectIsGone asserts the republished INDEX.md no longer contains the word Doomed.
Test Publish_EmitsMachineRecord asserts the record data is canonicalized so the posted keys come out sorted with a 1.50 value preserved.
Test Publish_EmitsMachineRecord asserts the single ref keeps target, rel supports, kind fact, basis observed, confidence 0.7 and rev r1 but omits etag.
Test Publish_EmitsMachineRecord asserts the record provenance actor is dossier-cli and that the prose keeps the bundle key instead of the store id.
Test Publish_EmitsMachineRecord asserts a fact posted without data has no data property in the record and carries its tag x.
Test Publish_ProfileReportFlagsViolations publishes 1200 modules against profiles/copilot-studio.json and asserts the max_files row fails with an allowed value of 500.
Test Publish_ProfileReportFlagsViolations asserts the rendered report contains FAIL and md (markdown) and that the normal bundle is written without any shards path.
Test Publish_RespectLimitsShardsUnderFileCap asserts at most 50 shard files exist and every shard text is at least 4096 bytes.
Test Publish_RespectLimitsShardsUnderFileCap asserts the manifest shard entries sum to 1200 subjects and that no subjects/ path is written.
Test Publish_ShardLinksUseAnchors asserts every shard link row matches shards/N.md#anchor form and that the named anchor element exists inside that shard file.
Test Publish_ShardLinksUseAnchors asserts the index files hold 150 shard rows with 150 distinct anchors.
Test Publish_ShardLinksUseAnchors asserts links inside a shard resolve to anchors that exist, treating an empty shard number as the current file.
Test Publish_ShardModeIsDeterministic asserts republishing into the same directory reports Written equal to 0.
Test Publish_ShardFailsClosedOnOversizedSubject asserts the error names django/contrib/app00/module0000 and max_file_bytes 64 and that no output directory is created.
Test Publish_ProfileRejectsMalformedFile asserts a profile with an unknown key max_filez is rejected with that key named in the message.
Test Publish_ProfileRejectsMalformedFile asserts a truncated profile reports not valid JSON and that no output directory exists afterwards.
Test Publish_ProfileRejectsMalformedFile asserts a string max_files and a string allowed_extensions are each rejected with the offending key named.
Test Publish_GenericProfileAcceptsMarkdown asserts profiles/generic-large.json reports allowed_extensions allowed of md and passes as a whole.
Test Publish_RespectLimitsRequiresProfile asserts RespectLimits with no profile throws an error naming --profile and writes no output directory.
Test Publish_ShardOpensWithContentsAndStatesFactFilesAbsent asserts shards/1.md opens with shard: 1 and carries fact_files: absent in its front matter.
Test Publish_ShardOpensWithContentsAndStatesFactFilesAbsent asserts every Contents anchor exists in the shard and that anchor count matches section count.
Test Publish_ShardOpensWithContentsAndStatesFactFilesAbsent asserts no /facts/ path survives in the shard, so citations stay plain keys.
Test Publish_DefaultsToComplete asserts a default publish of 200 facts writes all of them to the subject page with Facts shown: 200 facts and no Beyond the budget text.
Test Publish_DefaultsToComplete asserts the manifest options budget_mode value is complete.
Test Publish_StrictModeCutsToBudget asserts strict mode at budget 300 drops the full Facts shown line and adds Beyond the budget.
Test Publish_IndexTokenEstimateCoversCompletePage asserts the token estimate of the whole subject page exceeds 300 and equals the INDEX.md row cell at index 6.
Test Publish_InvalidBudgetModeRejected asserts BudgetMode nope throws DossierRequestException whose message contains strict.
Test Publish_ShardModeIsDeterministic publishes into two output directories and asserts the shard name lists match and every shard file is identical.
Test Publish_EveryInternalLinkResolves publishes each pass with IndexMaxTokens 700 and a budget taken from the pair 1200 and 60.
Test Publish_ProfileReportFlagsViolations asserts the min_file_bytes row fails and that the report Passed value is false.
Test Publish_ProfileReportFlagsViolations asserts the allowed_extensions row fails and that its actual value contains markdown.
Test Publish_EmitsMachineRecord asserts the pointer fact file ends with a closing code fence after the machine record block.
Test Publish_ShardOpensWithContentsAndStatesFactFilesAbsent asserts each Contents entry links to a hash anchor that the shard defines.
Test Publish_IndexLinksResolveAndReachEverySubject asserts the set of index files visited while following group rows equals the number of index files written.
TargetLine returns the single fact-file line beginning with two spaces, a dash and target: that contains the given needle.
at: factFile.Split('\n').Single(l => l.StartsWith("  - target: ", StringComparison.Ordinal) && l.Contains(needle, StringComparison.Ordinal));

facts.text: MachineRecordOf parses the JSON lines after the last Machine record heading, skipping the first and last fence lines.
TightProfile is a profile literal with max_files 50, min_file_bytes 4096, allowed_extensions pdf only, max_total_bytes 0 and max_path_depth 10.
Rejected returns the caught DossierRequestException and throws InvalidOperationException when the action succeeds instead.
at: throw new InvalidOperationException("expected a DossierRequestException, but the call succeeded");

facts.text: RepoFile climbs parent directories from AppContext.BaseDirectory until one holds a profiles directory, then joins the relative path onto it.
SeedMany builds each subject name from django/contrib/app plus the index divided by 40, and posts 3 facts whose overview string is padded with 120 x characters.
